integrity: All formulas proved algebraically and checked on stated finite cases. No empirical observation has been used as a substitute for infinite proof.
scientific_limitations: Restricted to two-hub trees, homogeneous independent vertex survival or a uniformly selected fixed-size survivor set.
Exogenous failure experiments are not equilibrium predictions and do not establish a new game-theoretic supportability theorem.
Previously known branch-weight and convex-order tools are not claimed to be independently new.
An unindexed equivalent theorem in graph reliability literature may exist.
title: Mean-identical but convexly ordered failure risks in two-hub public-goods networks
